instructions.title: Game Instructions
instructions.intro: Transcendance is an online gaming platform where you can play against a bot or other players in real-time in the classic Rock-Paper-Scissors game. Our version includes an Elo rating system to track your progress.
instructions.rulesDesc: The principle is simple: each player simultaneously chooses one of three elements. Here's how the winners are determined:
instructions.rockBeats: Rock (🪨) crushes Scissors (✂️) - You win if your opponent chooses Scissors
instructions.scissorsBeat: Scissors (✂️) cut Paper (📄) - You win if your opponent chooses Paper
instructions.paperBeats: Paper (📄) wraps Rock (🪨) - You win if your opponent chooses Rock
instructions.equal: Two identical choices = Draw, no one scores a point
instructions.vsBotStep1: Access the main menu from your personal space
instructions.vsBotStep2: Click on the 'Play against a bot' button (🤖)
instructions.vsBotStep3: A pop-up window appears to confirm your username - click 'Start!'
instructions.vsBotStep4: Choose from three options: Rock (🪨), Paper (📄) or Scissors (✂️)
instructions.vsBotStep5: The bot responds automatically and the result is displayed. First to 3 points wins the match
instructions.vsPlayerDesc: Play against other players in real-time with our matchmaking system:
instructions.vsPlayerStep1: Access the main menu from your personal space
instructions.vsPlayerStep2: Click on the 'Play against a player' button (👥)
instructions.vsPlayerStep3: Click 'Start!' - the system will search for an available opponent
instructions.vsPlayerStep4: Once an opponent is found, you have 5 seconds to make your choice
instructions.vsPlayerStep5: The first to 3 winning rounds wins the match. The results affect your Elo rating
instructions.winsLossesDesc: Each win and loss is recorded on your profile. Your win rate is calculated automatically: (wins / total games) × 100.
instructions.eloDesc: The Elo rating is a system used to calculate the relative skill level of players. Here's how it works on Transcendance:
instructions.eloWin: You gain Elo points when you defeat an opponent
instructions.eloLose: You lose Elo points when you are defeated
instructions.eloAgainst: The greater the rating difference with your opponent, the more Elo points you gain or lose
instructions.tip1: There is no foolproof strategy in Rock-Paper-Scissors, it's a game of pure chance. Each move has the same probability of winning.
instructions.tip2: Make your choice quickly! You only have 5 seconds per round in PvP mode before the system counts it as a timeout.
instructions.tip3: Regularly check your profile to track your progress and Elo rating.
instructions.tip4: Play against the bot to practice before facing real players.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.simpleDesc: We need some information for the game to work, that's all. No sales, no sharing with strangers, no dark patterns.
privacy.collectDesc: Just what's needed to play and recognize you:
privacy.gameStats: Your game statistics (wins, losses, Elo, etc.)
privacy.useDesc: To make the game work, simply put. Your account, your games, your rating... without this, we can't do much. We also use your IP address for security reasons (to prevent cheaters, spammers, etc.).
privacy.sharingDesc: No one, except you and us. We don't sell your data, we don't give it away, we don't share it.
privacy.sharingException: Except if the law requires us to (and that's rare).
privacy.cookiesDesc: We only use one to keep you logged in during your session. Nothing more. No tracking, no targeted ads, no reselling.
privacy.rightsDesc: You have the right to know what we have on you, to modify it, delete it, or retrieve it. It's the law (GDPR).
privacy.rightsContact: If you wish to exercise any of these rights, contact us and we will take care of it.
